As a guest visitor, I want to create an account with my name, phone or email and a password, so that I can track my orders and checkout faster next time.

Requirement: FR-01 — The system shall allow a guest to register a new account with full name, email or phone, and password.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am on the registration page and the phone is not already registered WHEN I submit a valid name, phone and a password of 8+ characters with a letter and a digit THEN my account is created, my password is stored hashed, and I am logged in
- GIVEN the phone or email is already registered WHEN I submit the form THEN I see "This phone/email is already registered" and no account is created

As a registered user, I want to log in with my credentials and log out, so that my orders and saved items are available to me only.

Requirement: FR-02 — The system shall allow registered users to log in securely and log out.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I have an active account WHEN I enter the correct email/phone and password THEN I am logged in and redirected to the page I came from
- GIVEN I entered a wrong password 5 times WHEN I try a 6th time within 15 minutes THEN the account is temporarily locked and I see when I can try again

As a registered customer, I want to reset my password if I forget it, so that I do not lose access to my account.

Requirement: FR-03 — The system shall allow a registered user to reset a forgotten password through a one-time code sent to the verified email or phone.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I requested a reset code for my registered phone WHEN I enter the valid code within 10 minutes and a new valid password THEN my password is changed and old sessions are signed out
- GIVEN the code is wrong or expired WHEN I submit it THEN I see "Invalid or expired code" and the password is unchanged

As a shopper, I want to browse products by category and brand, so that I can find the type of product I need.

Requirement: FR-04 — The system shall allow users to browse products by category and by brand.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am on the home page WHEN I open the "Supplements" category THEN I see only in-stock products of that category with name, image, price and an add button

As a shopper, I want to search by keyword and filter by brand, price and category, so that I quickly find the right product.

Requirement: FR-05 — The system shall allow users to search products by keyword (Arabic or English) and filter them by category, brand, price range and availability, and sort the results.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN products exist matching "whey" WHEN I search "whey" or "واي" and filter by brand and a price range THEN only matching products in that range are listed, within 2 seconds
- GIVEN nothing matches my search WHEN I submit it THEN I see a "no results" message with a link to all products

As a shopper, I want to see a product's images, flavours, price and stock, so that I can decide before buying.

Requirement: FR-06 — The system shall display a product detail page with images, description, variants (flavour/size), price, previous price if discounted, and stock status.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN a product has several flavours with different stock WHEN I open its page and pick a flavour THEN the price, image and stock status update for that flavour, and out-of-stock flavours cannot be added

As a shopper, I want to switch between Arabic and English, so that I can use the store in my language.

Requirement: FR-07 — The system shall allow users to switch the interface between Arabic (right-to-left) and English (left-to-right) and remember the choice.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am on any page in Arabic WHEN I choose English THEN the page shows English texts in left-to-right layout and the choice is kept on the next pages

As a shopper, I want to add products to a cart and change quantities, so that I can buy several products in one order.

Requirement: FR-08 — The system shall allow users to add products to a cart, change quantities and remove items, limited by available stock.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN a product variant has 3 items in stock WHEN I try to set its quantity to 4 THEN the quantity stays at 3 and I see "Only 3 left in stock"
- GIVEN my cart has items WHEN I remove one THEN the item disappears and the total is recalculated

As a shopper, I want to save products to a wishlist, so that I can buy them later.

Requirement: FR-09 — The system shall allow users to save products to a wishlist and move them to the cart.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am on a product page WHEN I tap "Add to wishlist" THEN the product appears in my wishlist and the wishlist counter increases

As a shopper, I want to place an order with my address and pay cash on delivery, so that the store delivers my products.

Requirement: FR-10 — The system shall allow users to place an order by entering name, phone, region, city and address, and confirming cash on delivery.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN my cart contains in-stock items WHEN I enter valid name, phone, region, city and address and click "Place order" THEN a new order is created with status Pending and stock is reserved
- GIVEN my cart is empty WHEN I open checkout THEN the "Place order" button is disabled and I see "Your cart is empty"
- GIVEN an item went out of stock after I added it WHEN I place the order THEN the order is not created and I am told which item to remove or reduce

As a shopper, I want to receive an order number and a WhatsApp summary, so that I have proof of my order.

Requirement: FR-11 — The system shall give the customer an order number after placing an order and send the order summary by WhatsApp.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN my order was created WHEN the confirmation page loads THEN I see the order number and a WhatsApp message with the order summary is sent to my phone

As a shopper, I want to track my order with its number and my phone, so that I know when it will arrive.

Requirement: FR-12 — The system shall allow users to track the status of an order using the order number and the phone number used in the order.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN order MM-1042 was placed with phone 0599xxxxxx WHEN I enter MM-1042 and that phone THEN I see the current status and the date of each status change
- GIVEN the phone does not match the order WHEN I submit THEN I see "Order not found" without revealing that the order exists

As a registered customer, I want to see my previous orders, so that I can reorder or check details.

Requirement: FR-13 — The system shall allow registered customers to view their order history and order details.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am logged in and have 2 orders WHEN I open "My orders" THEN I see both orders, newest first, with number, date, total and status

As a registered customer, I want to rate and review a product I received, so that other customers can benefit from my experience.

Requirement: FR-14 — The system shall allow registered customers to rate (1–5) and review products they received.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I have a Delivered order that contains the product WHEN I submit 4 stars and a comment THEN my review is saved as Pending moderation
- GIVEN I have no delivered order with the product WHEN I open the review form THEN I see "You can review products you have received"

As a shopper, I want to answer a few questions and get my daily calories and protein, so that I choose the right supplements.

Requirement: FR-15 — The system shall calculate daily calorie and protein targets from the user's answers (age, height, weight, activity, goal) and suggest matching products.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I answered all required questions WHEN I click "Show my numbers" THEN I see calorie and protein targets, suggested products and the "not medical advice" notice

As a shopper, I want to browse exercises and training programs by muscle group and level, so that I can train correctly.

Requirement: FR-16 — The system shall allow users to browse an exercise library and training programs, filtered by muscle group, level and equipment.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN the exercise library is open WHEN I filter by "Chest" and "Beginner" THEN only beginner chest exercises are listed with images and steps

As a administrator, I want to add, edit and delete products and their variants and images, so that the catalog stays up to date.

Requirement: FR-17 — The system shall allow administrators to create, edit and delete products, variants, images, categories and brands.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN I am logged in as Admin WHEN I create a product with name (AR/EN), category, brand, price and one variant THEN the product appears on the site and in search
- GIVEN I am logged in as Employee WHEN I open the catalog editor THEN access is denied (HTTP 403)

As a administrator or employee, I want to update stock quantities (and prices as admin), so that customers see correct availability and prices.

Requirement: FR-18 — The system shall allow employees and administrators to update stock quantities, and administrators to update prices.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN a variant has stock 0 WHEN an Employee sets it to 10 THEN the variant becomes available on the site
- GIVEN I am an Employee WHEN I try to change a price THEN the request is rejected (HTTP 403)

As a store employee, I want to see orders and change their status, so that customers get their orders on time.

Requirement: FR-19 — The system shall allow employees and administrators to view all orders, filter them by status and date, and change an order's status according to the allowed transitions.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN an order is Pending WHEN I change it to Confirmed THEN the status and the time of change are saved and visible in tracking
- GIVEN an order is Delivered WHEN I try to change it to Pending THEN the change is refused because Delivered is final

As a administrator, I want to manage accounts and roles, so that only authorised staff can use the back office.

Requirement: FR-20 — The system shall allow administrators to manage user accounts and assign roles (Customer, Employee, Admin).

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN a user has the Customer role WHEN I assign the Employee role THEN the user can open the orders screen at next login

As a administrator, I want to see sales and stock for a period, so that I can plan purchasing.

Requirement: FR-21 — The system shall allow administrators to view sales and stock reports for a chosen period.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN there are delivered orders this month WHEN I open the sales report for this month THEN I see order count, revenue and best-selling products for that period

As a administrator, I want to approve or hide reviews, so that only appropriate reviews are public.

Requirement: FR-22 — The system shall allow administrators to approve, hide or delete product reviews.

Acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN a review is Pending WHEN I approve it THEN it appears on the product page and the product rating is recalculated
